text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P2, update ingestion boundary to existing estimates. EstimateGroup already compiles pinned estimate inputs, validates participant/target/product/pooling identities with mandatory scientific/grid admission, and reads bounded spatial blocks into GroupData while retaining input receipts. Therefore a new FirstLevelCatalog-specific GroupBlockSource must not duplicate that reader or revive the retired ResultManifest authority. Remaining work is scheduler-neutral persisted group execution and output publication around EstimateGroup plus existing GroupEngine, with dense-versus-block independent equivalence, whole-call memory/read budgets and lineage-preserving result sinks. Include repeated integrity-scan costs from the current reader in performance receipts. Do not conflate supplied variances with calibrated inference; admission/provenance and estimator expansion remain their own P1/research tasks. Preserve missing/invalid input refusals and the stable estimate-format dependency without requiring unrelated app orchestration. Source inspection only; no new execution/performance qualification.
